newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares steady, focus on PT, Cimpor.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares steady, focus on PT, Cimpor.

text.p: 1159 GMT - Portuguese shares were steady in early trade, with activity focused on Portugal Telecom, strengthening in line with the closing New York price, and cement firm Cimpor, as today is the last day that shares can be bought with the right to the next dividend payments. Operators said U.S. economic data and the expected release of Portugal's April consumer price inflation data this week would help set a trend for prices.
* "The market is very calm and will probably stay this way until the close, unless New York rises sharply again at the opening and drags the national market with it," said one operator.
